text:
{
  "task": "Manage multi-channel marketing campaigns including email, landing pages, and webinars within a single platform.",
  "benefits": [
    "Consolidates marketing tools into one platform, eliminating the need to stitch together separate tools.",
    "Reduces manual campaign setup time by roughly five hours weekly with a visual workflow builder.",
    "Automatically syncs webinar attendee data and triggers tailored follow-up emails, improving lead engagement.",
    "Provides client-facing campaign summary reports with custom dashboards and read-only access, saving time on manual reporting."
  ],
  "frictions": [
    "Counts a single lead as multiple billable contacts if they appear on more than one client list, leading to unpredictable billing spikes.",
    "Lacks native sub-account controls for managing multiple B2B clients, creating data privacy risks and preventing full isolation of client assets.",
    "Has a rigid custom reporting engine that cannot combine cross-channel marketing metrics into tailored client performance dashboards.",
    "Has a limited webinar recording storage cap, requiring manual download and archiving of recordings."
  ]
}

json.task: Manage multi-channel marketing campaigns including email, landing pages, and webinars within a single platform.
benefits: Consolidates marketing tools into one platform, eliminating the need to stitch together separate tools.
Reduces manual campaign setup time by roughly five hours weekly with a visual workflow builder.
Automatically syncs webinar attendee data and triggers tailored follow-up emails, improving lead engagement.
Provides client-facing campaign summary reports with custom dashboards and read-only access, saving time on manual reporting.
frictions: Counts a single lead as multiple billable contacts if they appear on more than one client list, leading to unpredictable billing spikes.
Lacks native sub-account controls for managing multiple B2B clients, creating data privacy risks and preventing full isolation of client assets.
Has a rigid custom reporting engine that cannot combine cross-channel marketing metrics into tailored client performance dashboards.
Has a limited webinar recording storage cap, requiring manual download and archiving of recordings.
